scope: descriptive fixed-horizon path and identical DM3 replay comparison; frozen OWN1; no retuning; exact GGI proximity is diagnostic only

protocol.management: DM3 V2: next-open; moving Mean wick 25% partial; static signal-bar opposite Inner wick full; static 12xSMA(TR,55) stop; adverse-first; no BE; no add
protocol.own1: body >= 1.5x SMA20(body); drought >= 10 bars since Mean touch; signal-side Mean close; directional candle; same-side cooldown 40
protocol.path: uncensored fixed-horizon MFE/MAE from next-open, normalized by signal-time 12xSMA(TR,55) risk
protocol.primaryNull: same dataset/template side/calendar month/ATR55 quintile; deterministic draws; same-side cooldown; fallback tiers recorded
protocol.secondaryNull: same dataset/template side only; deterministic draws; same-side cooldown
protocol.bootstrap: 500 monthly-block paired resamples across deterministic null draws
